title: CMNIE：中文军事新闻信息抽取基准
summary: CMNIE是面向中文军事新闻的信息抽取基准，统一标注事件触发词、事件论元、命名实体和实体关系，包含13,000条实例，覆盖7种事件类型、10种论元角色、7种实体类型和8种关系类型。实验表明该基准仍具挑战性，尤其在关系抽取和事件论元跨度精确匹配方面，零样本LLM常能识别语义单元但无法精确匹配金标跨度。
summary_en: CMNIE is an information extraction benchmark for Chinese military news that jointly annotates event triggers, event arguments, named entities, and entity relations under a unified schema. It contains 13,000 instances with 7 event types, 10 argument roles, 7 entity types, and 8 relation types. Experiments show CMNIE remains challenging, especially for relation extraction and exact span matching, where zero-shot LLMs often identify relevant semantics but fail to match gold span boundaries.
